description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams activated OL Justin Dedich from injured reserve.
items.impact: Dedich will return for Wednesday's game against the Packers.
items.title: Justin Dedich activated from IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams activated Kobie Turner from injured reserve.
items.impact: Turner will return for Wednesday's game against the Packers.
items.title: Kobie Turner (groin) activated from IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Abraham Lucas has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Lucas was unable to get healthy during the bye week. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Abraham Lucas (ankle) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Quenton Nelson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Nelson was unable to get healthy during the bye week. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Quenton Nelson (knee) will not play in Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sam Darnold will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Darnold continues to trend towards returning for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.title: Sam Darnold (quad/rib) will practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Stefon Diggs is not at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Diggs is away due to personal reasons. He will need to be monitored in practice on Thursday.
items.title: Stefon Diggs (personal) not at practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers released QB Aaron Rodgers.
items.impact: This news comes within an hour after Rodgers went onto the Pat McAfee airing out information on Mike McCarthy and his time being with him in Pittsburgh and Green Bay. Aaron Rodgers had said entering this year that this would be his final season. It is unclear what will be next for him.
items.title: Aaron Rodgers released by Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Derrick Henry was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Henry is in concussion protocol. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Derrick Henry (concussion) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Dak Prescott (hand) is off of the injury report Wednesday for the Dallas Cowboys according to Todd Archer.
items.impact: Prescott is good to go after a short walkthrough practice week, as the signal-caller leads a high-octane passing attack against the Eagles Thanksgiving Day.
items.title: Dak Prescott (hand) off injury report for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brock Purdy is not practicing on Wednesday due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Purdy injured his ankle in the second quarter last Sunday. 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said it's not a high ankle and he is day to day.
items.title: Brock Purdy (ankle) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins RT Austin Jackson said he expects to play on Sunday against the Jets.
items.impact: Jackson will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Austin Jackson expected to play in Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brock Bowers practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said he was optimistic that Bowers will play on Sunday night against the Browns.
items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) practices Wednesday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jake Ferguson (ankle/knee) has been ruled out for Week 12 for the Dallas Cowboys against the Philadelphia Eagles according to Todd Archer.
items.impact: Ferguson will miss a second consecutive contest while battling a multitude of injuries, with Brevyn Spann-Ford and James Mitchell in line for increased snaps against the Eagles Thanksgiving Day.
items.title: Jake Ferguson (ankle/knee) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Harrison Smith was estimated as a "DNP" in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is only a walkthrough on Wednesday for the Vikings. Smith will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Harrison Smith estimated as a "DNP" in practice Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Washington Commanders signed WR Brandon Aiyuk.
items.impact: Aiyuk was signed to the practice squad, but he should be elevated for Sunday's game against the Cardinals. He'll likely be eased back initially after all this time away from football. He'll be tough to trust for fantasy managers signing this late into the season, but he could be worth a speculative stash.
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk signs with Commanders
